summary.summary: The customer, Kevin, called Arizona Roofers to address a leaking flat roof over his patio, which has been progressively worsening. The roof was built in 2006 and had solar panels installed, but the leak is not related to the solar installation. The customer_rep, Travis, informed Kevin that the soonest they could complete the repair would be in 7 to 9 weeks due to high volume. Kevin was advised to consider hiring a local roofing handyman if he needed the issue resolved sooner.
key_points: Solar panels installed, but not the cause of the leak
Alternative: hiring a local roofing handyman
action_items: Consider hiring a local roofing handyman
next_steps: Kevin to decide on next course of action
Travis to follow up if Kevin decides to proceed with Arizona Roofers

pending_actions.raw_text: Travis said to call back if Kevin can't find anybody and needs to get booked
Kevin to check with local roofing handymen for availability

positive_behaviors: REP was honest and transparent about timeline constraints
REP suggested helpful alternatives when unable to schedule

objections.objection_text: 7 to 9 weeks is a long time

qualification.follow_up_reason: Sales Briefing: 2006-built flat roof with active leak getting progressively worse. Company timeline 7-9 weeks too long, customer may look for faster alternatives
